name: inquire_service_availability
description: The chatbot responds to the user's inquiry about available services and indicates that the question will be forwarded to the staff.

name: provide_payments_information
description: The chatbot provides detailed instructions on how to find payment information for taxes through the Virtual Tax Office and other resources.

name: provide_tax_payment_information
description: Provides details regarding the mandatory nature of tax payments as required by law.

name: provide_office_location_info
description: Informs the user about options for requesting a payment installment plan and offers a link to the geographical situation of different tax management offices.

outputs.description: Information on various tax management offices and their hours.

name: provide_virtual_tax_office_access
description: Instructs the user on how to access the Virtual Tax Office, including relevant information about tax management services.

outputs.description: Information about the types of taxes managed or collected.
Instructions for accessing the Virtual Tax Office.
Phone number for assistance with tax management services.

name: provide_office_information
description: Informs the user about various offices of the Tax Management Service, including their operating hours and geographical locations.

outputs.description: URL and information about various tax management offices, including their geographical locations and operating hours.

name: provide_information_about_obligatory_taxes
description: The chatbot provides options for accessing information about the types of obligatory taxes managed or collected by the Diputación.

outputs.description: Details on when taxes and fees are due
Phone number and hours for customer service assistance
Information on using the Virtual Tax Office with and without a digital certificate.

name: list_tax_procedures_catalog
description: Provides a link to the catalog of tax procedures available for the user to consult, although the user request was not directly fulfilled with the catalog link.

outputs.description: URL of the tax procedures catalog for user reference.

name: provide_tax_calendar_information
description: Provides users with information and resources to access the tax calendar, including access methods and contact information for tax support.

outputs.description: Information on accessing tax payment dates through the Oficina Virtual Tributaria and by phone, including options for accessing the tax calendar with or without a digital certificate.
Phone number for tax-related inquiries and assistance (963 00 05 00) available Monday to Friday from 8:30 AM to 2:30 PM.
Direct link to the tax calendar page.

name: prompt_for_geographical_office_consultation
description: Repeatedly prompts the user to consult the geographical offices of the Tax Management Service, providing a button for access and a link to their schedules.

outputs.description: Provides a link to the geographical offices and their schedules, including their hours of operation.
